svg.text: AI Interview Evaluator — User Interface Blueprint
How to use every tab · Inputs · Buttons · Outputs · Workflow
Find violations in a conversation against a system prompt
Large textarea — paste or type the recruiter agent's system prompt
This is what the AI agent follows during the interview
e.g. "You are Sarah, a recruiter at Acme Corp. Your goal is to..."
✦ Auto-filled when you come back from Runner tab (uses agent prompt)
Upload a conversation file (.json or .txt format)
✦ Auto-loaded from Runner after conversation ends
After evaluation: violations appear as numbered list
Type violation number → press Enter or click Remove to delete it
Sends violations JSON + current system prompt to Fixer tab automatically
📜 Streaming text — raw LLM response appears live as it generates
📋 Violations JSON — parsed structured list (editable inline)
🧠 Thinking tokens chip (Gemini only) — shown separately from output
Model name · Input tokens · Output tokens · [Thinking tokens] · Total · Cost $
Mimo: cost not tracked (internal) · Gemini: thinking included in billed output
Save mistakes · Save prompt · Save transcript — stored in db/ folder
• Use Gemini for best results — it reasons before answering
• Delete false-positive violations with the number input before sending to Fixer
• After Runner completes, come back here — transcript + prompt are auto-loaded
• Undo/redo lets you revert accidental violation removals
Repair a broken system prompt based on evaluation violations
The current (broken) system prompt that needs to be fixed
Large editable textarea — paste manually or auto-filled
e.g. "You are Sarah, a recruiter. Ask about work experience..."
✦ Auto-filled when you click "Send to Fixer" from Evaluator tab
The violations JSON from the Evaluator tab
Fixer uses this to know what rules were broken and how to fix them
✦ Auto-filled when you click "Send to Fixer" from Evaluator tab
Sends both inputs to Groq llama-3.3-70b · streams the repaired prompt live
Sends fixed prompt to Runner tab · appears below diff view after run completes
📜 Streaming raw text — fixed prompt streams in live
Side-by-side or inline diff between old and new prompt
- You are a recruiter. Ask about
+ You are Sarah, a recruiter at Acme.
Full repaired prompt shown in monospace card
• Both fields auto-fill — you rarely need to type anything here
• Review the diff carefully — make sure the changes make sense
• You can manually edit the old prompt textarea before running the fixer
• "Send to Runner" button appears below the diff once fixer completes
Run a simulated interview conversation between recruiter + candidate
Choose which LLM plays the recruiter "Sarah" role
The system prompt the recruiter agent follows
Config JSON variables like {name} get substituted automatically
✦ Auto-filled when you click "Send to Runner" from Fixer tab
Defines how the candidate LLM responds (personality, background)
Key-value pairs injected into prompts · e.g. {"name": "Alice", "role": "backend engineer"}
Shows ✓ green when valid JSON · ✗ red border when invalid
Click to start — then choose a mode below
Stops mid-conversation · saves usage so far
Type your reply in the input box
📋 Substituted Agent Prompt — final prompt after config variables injected
💰 Token Usage Bar (updates live every turn)
Agent model · In / Cached / Out · Cost | Candidate · In / Out · Cost | Total
• All 3 inputs auto-fill — just verify config JSON is valid (shows ✓)
• Manual Mode is great for testing how the agent handles tricky answers
• Agent stops automatically when it says "end_call" — no action needed
• "Send to Evaluator" downloads the transcript AND switches tabs at once

① Open Evaluator · upload transcript + paste system prompt · click Evaluate (Gemini) → ② violations auto-fill Fixer · click Fix Prompt · review diff · Send to Runner → ③ Config loads auto · click Run Conversation · choose Auto or Manual · end conversation · Send to Evaluator → repeat
